description: Read-only diagnostics for one Code Engine app: running instances, logs, Kubernetes events (why it will not start), and revisions (what to roll back to). Identify the app with project_id and app_name. Call get_schema with name ce_app_inspect for every action's fields.

action.description: instances: List running instances, or one with instance_name. | logs: Get recent logs from all instances, or one with instance_name. | events: Get platform events such as ImagePullBackOff or CrashLoopBackOff (kept about 60 minutes). | revisions: List revisions, or one with revision_name.

app_name.description: Application name, from ce_app action list.

instance_name.description: Optional: return only this instance. Omit to list all instances.

namespace.description: Optional: project namespace (subdomain) override, if it cannot be auto-derived.

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

revision_name.description: Optional: return this revision only. Omit to list all revisions.

tail_lines.description: Number of log lines to return per pod (default: 100)

name: ce_app_inspect
